full_judgment: 39. In dealing with an appeal against acquittal the Court will, naturally, keep in mind the presumption of innocence in favour of the accused, it reinforced, by the judgment of acquittal. But, in the appropriate case, this Division will not abjure its duty to prevent violent miscarriage of justice by hesitating to interfere where interference is imperative.
